name: PRVVSM02.jcl
description:
This JCL job (PRVVSM02) initializes two VSAM Key-Sequenced Data Sets (KSDS) used in the Medicaid Management Information System (MMIS) Provider Screening and Sanctioning process. It first removes any existing versions of the files and then recreates them with defined storage and record specifications to ensure a clean, structured environment for screening results and sanction master data.Key Functionalities:
Deletes the existing MMPRV.SCREEN.RESULTS.KSDS cluster (if present) to allow fresh recreation, suppressing any errors from a non-existent file by resetting the maximum condition code to 0.
Deletes the existing MMPRV.SANCTION.MASTER.KSDS cluster (if present) to allow fresh recreation, with the same error suppression logic applied.
Recreates the Screen Results KSDS (MMPRV.SCREEN.RESULTS.KSDS) as an indexed file with an 18-byte key starting at position 0, fixed record size of 67 bytes, and initial allocation of 10 cylinders with 5 cylinder secondary extents.
Recreates the Sanction Master KSDS (MMPRV.SANCTION.MASTER.KSDS) as an indexed file with a 10-byte key starting at position 0, fixed record size of 80 bytes, and initial allocation of 5 cylinders with 2 cylinder secondary extents.
Both files are defined with share options (2,3), allowing concurrent read access across multiple jobs while permitting controlled write access.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: A batch initialization process is triggered for sanction screening and the Sanction Screening Results data store (MMPRV.SCREEN.RESULTS.KSDS) may or may not exist
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The system processes the deletion of the Sanction Screening Results data store
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: The Sanction Screening Results data store — including all its screening result records and its lookup index — is permanently and completely removed, overriding any expiry date or data retention settings that may have been applied to the store

rules.Rule_Name: DEFKSDS - IDCAMS - Delete Sanction Screening Results Data Store Before Batch Cycle
rules.Rule_Description: Before a new batch cycle begins, the existing Sanction Screening Results data store must be completely and unconditionally removed to ensure a clean slate for fresh screening data.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: A batch initialization process is triggered for sanction screening and the Sanction Master data store (MMPRV.SANCTION.MASTER.KSDS) may or may not exist
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The system processes the deletion of the Sanction Master reference data store
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: The Sanction Master data store — including all its sanctioned entity records and its lookup index — is permanently and completely removed, overriding any expiry date or data retention settings that may have been applied to the store

rules.Rule_Name: DEFKSDS - IDCAMS - Delete Sanction Master Reference Data Store Before Batch Cycle
rules.Rule_Description: Before a new batch cycle begins, the existing Sanction Master reference data store must be completely and unconditionally removed to ensure the master list of sanctioned entities is always rebuilt fresh.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: The deletion of the Sanction Screening Results data store and/or the Sanction Master data store has been attempted
Acceptance_Criteria.When: Either or both deletion attempts result in an error because the data stores do not yet exist
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: The error status is explicitly reset to success (0) so that batch initialization continues forward to the data store creation steps without interruption — ensuring the job executes successfully on both first-time runs and all subsequent runs

rules.Rule_Name: DEFKSDS - IDCAMS - Ensure Uninterrupted Processing When Data Stores Do Not Exist
rules.Rule_Description: The batch initialization must continue to create both data stores even if the prior deletion steps fail — for example, on a first-time run when neither data store has been created yet.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: The Sanction Screening Results data store has been deleted or does not exist, and the error status has been confirmed as success
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The system creates a new Sanction Screening Results data store named MMPRV.SCREEN.RESULTS.KSDS with its associated data component (MMPRV.SCREEN.RESULTS.DATA) and index component (MMPRV.SCREEN.RESULTS.INDEX)
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: The data store is created as an indexed, key-sequenced store with the following rules enforced: (1) Every screening result record must be exactly 67 bytes in length — no shorter, no longer; (2) Every screening result record must carry a unique 18-character identifier positioned at the very start of the record (characters 1 through 18), which is used to directly locate any specific screening result; (3) Within the same processing environment, multiple processes may read screening results simultaneously, but only one process is permitted to write at any given time; (4) Across different processing environments, both reading and writing are permitted concurrently; (5) An initial storage capacity of 10 cylinders is reserved, with automatic expansion of 5 additional cylinders whenever the store reaches capacity

rules.Rule_Name: DEFKSDS - IDCAMS - Initialize Sanction Screening Results Data Store Structure
rules.Rule_Description: A fresh, empty Sanction Screening Results data store must be created with precisely defined record structure, unique key definition, concurrent access rules, and storage capacity to support sanction screening transaction processing.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: The Sanction Master data store has been deleted or does not exist, and the error status has been confirmed as success
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The system creates a new Sanction Master reference data store named MMPRV.SANCTION.MASTER.KSDS with its associated data component (MMPRV.SANCTION.MASTER.DATA) and index component (MMPRV.SANCTION.MASTER.INDEX)
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: The data store is created as an indexed, key-sequenced store with the following rules enforced: (1) Every sanction master record must be exactly 80 bytes in length — no shorter, no longer; (2) Every sanction master record must carry a unique 10-character identifier positioned at the very start of the record (characters 1 through 10), which is used to directly locate any specific sanctioned entity; (3) Within the same processing environment, multiple processes may read sanction master records simultaneously, but only one process is permitted to write at any given time; (4) Across different processing environments, both reading and writing are permitted concurrently; (5) An initial storage capacity of 5 cylinders is reserved, with automatic expansion of 2 additional cylinders whenever the store reaches capacity

rules.Rule_Name: DEFKSDS - IDCAMS - Initialize Sanction Master Reference Data Store Structure
rules.Rule_Description: A fresh, empty Sanction Master reference data store must be created with precisely defined record structure, unique key definition, concurrent access rules, and storage capacity to support sanctioned entity reference lookups.
